subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB3613
title: Creates the Office of Pharmaceutical Purchasing within the Oregon Department of Administrative Services to support multiagency and multistate collaborative purchasing of pharmaceuticals, drive down the cost of prescription drugs for residents of this state and manage the Oregon Prescription Drug Program.
headline: HB 3613 did not pass

claims.text: HB 3613 was introduced in the House on February 18, 2025.
